story.titleZh: 阿斯顿·马丁：斯特罗尔因设定调整与维修将从维修区起步
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车队宣布，由于设定调整和损伤修复，斯特罗尔将在美国大奖赛从维修区起步，并借机更换了动力单元和电池。

story.summaryEn:
Due to set-up changes and damage repair we've elected to start Lance from the pitlane today.
We've also taken this opportunity to replace his PU and battery.
#USGP
detailZh:
由于调校调整和损坏修复，我们今天选择让兰斯从维修区起步。
我们也借此机会更换了他的动力单元（PU）和电池。
#USGP
detailEn:
Due to set-up changes and damage repair we've elected to start Lance from the pitlane today.
We've also taken this opportunity to replace his PU and battery.
#USGP
